sources.text: At noon the water was still. Three reeds leaned toward the bank. I thought the closed gate might explain the low water. At noon the water was still. The repeated sentence was copied from the earlier page.

sources.text: A bird stood beside the café terrace. By evening the water reached the lowest step. It may have risen after the gate opened, although I did not see the gate move. The cause remains uncertain.
